photoScope: Paused photo variants do not establish physical play in those variants; actualQuality/actualZoom remain authoritative. Reviewed photos are marked.
timingScope: Gameplay tick clocks only; RAF data discarded without performance analysis.
qualification: Real physical input with no assists/deaths/issues in this segment. Normal checkpoint weapon pickups; player takes damage in first segment. Native resident/attack rates are a separate route. Direct HUD movement does not certify every authored encounter trigger or every-region combat.
sampleCompaction: Retained full L9/L10 sample clocks; L8 sampled at >=1-second spacing plus step/death/visibility/quality/zero-armor transitions. visibleInfectedCount is the full count; visibleInfected IDs are limited to eight and nearest records to four. Complete roster fields, separate death/boarding ledgers, route coordinates and image hashes are retained. No full infection-lifecycle census is claimed.
